description: This file defines the 'Partition' class implementing AWS partition logic, including region matching, endpoint resolution, and handling legacy endpoints within the AWS SDK.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Final class implementing AWS partition interface, managing region and endpoint data, including legacy endpoint handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Partition object with required partition data, validating presence of essential keys.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the partition.

methods.name: getDnsSuffix
methods.description: Returns the DNS suffix associated with the partition.

methods.name: isRegionMatch
methods.description: Checks if a given region and service match the partition's region patterns.

methods.name: getAvailableEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves available endpoints for a specified service, considering regional and global endpoints.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Generates endpoint data including URL, signature version, and signing info based on input arguments.

methods.name: getEndpointData
methods.description: Fetches endpoint configuration data for a specific service and region.

methods.name: getSignatureVersion
methods.description: Determines the signature version to use based on endpoint data.

methods.name: resolveRegion
methods.description: Resolves the effective region, considering legacy and global endpoint rules.

methods.name: isServicePartitionGlobal
methods.description: Checks if a service is globally partitioned and not regionalized.

methods.name: isStsLegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Determines if a legacy STS endpoint should be used for a region.

methods.name: isS3LegacyEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if a legacy S3 endpoint should be used for a region.

methods.name: getPartitionEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the partition endpoint for a service.

methods.name: formatEndpoint
methods.description: Formats the endpoint URL by replacing placeholders with actual values.

methods.name: isFipsEndpointUsed
methods.description: Checks if a region indicates a FIPS endpoint.

methods.name: getVariant
methods.description: Determines the endpoint variant based on options such as FIPS and dual-stack.
